deadline.intake: Study year 2027-2028, regular bachelor programmes, non-EU applicants (numerus fixus: 15 Jan 2027)

tuition.note: Academic year 2027-2028, full-time, lowest band (Economics and Business, Humanities, Law); up to 32,000 for Medicine and Dentistry

requirement.text: Applicants with a non-Dutch qualification need a general level equivalent to Dutch pre-university education (VWO); the Admissions Board assesses the diploma and some faculties have subject-specific requirements.
